final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS health_status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS scan_total, AVG(1.0 * sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_size_per_minute) AS overall_average FROM step1) SELECT step1.health_status, step1.scan_total, step1.avg_size_per_minute, step1.avg_size_per_minute - step2.overall_average FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.overall_average IS NOT NULL AND step1.avg_size_per_minute > step2.overall_average
